violationsA: Incorrectly identifies the fix: WeakHashMap does not solve the leak of the Map object itself held by the ThreadLocal in a pooled thread environment.
Fails to mention the requirement to use a finally block.
Fails to explain that pooled threads are reused and never terminate.
Provides a solution that doesn't address the fact that the Map itself is never removed from the ThreadLocal.
rationale: Candidate A provides an incorrect fix. Using a WeakHashMap inside a ThreadLocal does not prevent the leak in a pooled thread environment because the ThreadLocal still holds a strong reference to the Map object itself. Candidate B correctly identifies that the ThreadLocal must be cleared (removed) to prevent the Map from persisting across requests on reused threads. Candidate B also correctly explains the growth over time due to thread reuse and the lack of cleanup.
